title: A consensus cross-species catabolic signature of spaceflight-induced muscle atrophy: meta-analysis of NASA OSDR transcriptomics, pathway mapping, and translation to plant-based nutritional countermeasures
description:
This repository hosts the data and analysis pipeline for re-deriving a consensus cross-species catabolic signature of spaceflight-induced muscle atrophy and translating these findings into evidence-based countermeasures. We integrate rodent and human spaceflight datasets from the NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR), perform connectivity mapping using the LINCS L1000 database to identify counter-catabolic compounds, validate candidate nutraceuticals via molecular docking, and design optimized plant-based meal plans to meet muscle protein synthesis (MPS) thresholds.

Includes the full results tables, SVG/PNG figures, R/Python plans, molecular docking coordinates, and draft manuscript. All code is MIT-licensed; data and figures are CC-BY-4.0.
